rigLooks.source: moxir-2026-10-17-minimal-halo-heads.json (MOXIR 17.10 — Minimal · halo · heads, 2026-09-28) · groups renamed to position/type by scripts/rigbuild/looks.mjs

looks.title: Blackout + one beam
looks.intent: Everything out but one: the apex beam, hung at the triangle's point over the pit, straight down — a white pillar between the crowd and the DJ, who stands behind it as a shape. The other six halo beams wait in the dark already turned to the next look (a move in black, never a move seen).

looks.title: Slow sweep
looks.intent: The halo opens OUTWARD to the crowd: all seven beams leave the triangle along its own directions, bent toward the house and dipped 24° under the horizon, over the heads of the floor; the column beams lean out to the walls in pairs, the columns and the bridge glow low red. A held frame of a slow sweep; nothing flashes.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red, and low: the apex and the four side beams stand round the DJ as a red cage landing on the floor 2.6 m out from him; the two base-corner beams cross in an X just over his head (3.1 m above the deck) and run on down past him — the X on the DJ. The columns, the press and the bridge glow red from below; the roof stays black.

looks.title: White cathedral
looks.intent: The cone on the DJ: all seven halo beams close in to a ring 1.3 m round the performer at deck height — a cone of cold white with the DJ standing untouched inside it; the column beams stand straight up in mirrored pairs down the nave. Everything else dark.

looks.title: Strobe hit
looks.intent: The peak: the two strobes on the halo's base edge flash out over the DJ into the crowd and the pit strobes rake up from the floor; every beam and PAR out so the flash lands on black. The halo beams keep the cone's aim, dark (no head moves under a strobe).
